title: PureHealth performs GCC’s first separation of craniopagus twins’ procedure in Abu Dhabi
excerpt: Source: Abu Dhabi Media Office In a landmark achievement, Abu Dhabi has successfully hosted the complex surgical separation of conjoined twins from Nigeria. The life-saving surgery was performed at PureHealth’s SEHA – Sheikh Khalifa Medical City (SKMC) in Abu Dhabi.
